fusions.name: Clean Slash
fusions.desc: Sends a thin bolt that deals 7 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It holds 5 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Loose Leaves
fusions.desc: Looses 5 bolts in a spread, each dealing 6 damage and ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Struck Out
fusions.desc: Removes up to 12 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Margin Notes
fusions.desc: Your other abilities' cooldowns are 8% shorter. Your armour rises 10%.
